notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
